M24 — 2026-10-10
Cloud probes from an agent shell: `claude --cloud` refuses a non-TTY, so start it under `script -q <log> claude --cloud "<prompt>"`. Follow-ups work non-interactively with `claude -p "<msg>" --cloud <session_id> --output-format json`. Until the Claude GitHub App is installed on usesofar/sofar, a cloud session is a bundle with no remote and its push gets a 403, so ask the session to paste results in its reply.
